newsitem.title: INDIA: India issues cyclone warning for southern coast.
newsitem.headline: India issues cyclone warning for southern coast.

text.p: A cylonic storm with winds of 120 to 150 km per hour was expected to cross the southern Indian coast around midnight (1830 GMT) on Wednesday, the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) statement said.
The statement said at 2.30 p.m the severe cyclonic storm was centred about 100 km southeast of Kakinada in the soutern state of Andhra Pradesh and was likely to intensify further.
The state is on the coast of the Bay of Bengal.
Rains or thundershowers were likely to occur in the coastal Vishakapatnam, East and West Godavari, Krishna, Guntur and Prakasam districts in Andhra Pradesh, the statement said.
"Fishermen are advised not to venture into the sea off Andhra Pradesh coast during the next 36 hours," the statement said.
